status: PROPOSED protocol, frozen as a procedure before any outcome; NOT executable until every 'pending' item is resolved and calibrated=true

primary_capability_panel.protocol: zero-shot generative multiple choice, prompt = pinned Inspect mmlu_pro task template (inspect_evals b49df6bc...), NOT a reproduction of publisher five-shot numbers

final_sample.rule: 30 per subject x 14 subjects, drawn without replacement with seed 20260929 over items sorted by question_id

primary_capability_panel.scorer: extract the single option letter (A-J) from the FINAL channel with the pinned Inspect answer pattern; no extraction -> EXTRACTION_FAILURE (scored 0); NO random guessing

prompt_template.note: byte-identical to the pinned Inspect USER_PROMPT_TEMPLATE (checked by AST extraction); sha256 in prompts-lock.json

primary_capability_panel.protocol: exact H4 items and unique_id; NOT the generic Inspect MATH task (different dataset, temperature 0.5 override, model-judge scorer)

final_sample.rule: all 500 items stratified by (subject, level); 100 items reserved for development by proportional largest-remainder allocation (ties broken by stratum name), seed 20260929; the remaining 400 are final

primary_capability_panel.scorer: Math-Verify (huggingface/Math-Verify ba3d3aaf...) parse+verify of the FINAL channel against the H4 'answer' field; deterministic, no judge model; runs in a subprocess with a hard timeout (no SIGALRM dependency); parse failure -> EXTRACTION_FAILURE
primary_capability_panel.scorer_status: pending: source fetched (math_verify parser.py/grader.py, sha256 in evaluation-files-lock.json) but the package is not installed/tested; synthetic fixture suite must pass before execution

prompt_template.note: byte-identical to the pinned Inspect MATH USER_PROMPT_TEMPLATE; answer is read from the 'ANSWER:' line of the FINAL channel, then verified by Math-Verify

primary_capability_panel.ceiling_note: strong models may saturate; MATH-500 is reported as mathematical reliability, not used for small-gap winner claims

primary_capability_panel.protocol: task-balanced SAMPLE of BBEH, reported as 'BBEH-sampled micro accuracy' with per-task breakdown; never labelled the official full BBEH score and no harmonic-mean full-benchmark claim

final_sample.rule: 20 items per task x 23 tasks (task count VERIFIED from the pinned tree: 22 tasks x 200 items + disambiguation_qa 120 = 4,520), seed 20260929; 2 items per task (46) reserved for development, disjoint

primary_capability_panel.scorer: official bbeh/evaluate.py evaluate_correctness at the pinned revision (functions vendored; the module prints example results at import time, so it is not imported as-is), applied to the FINAL channel
primary_capability_panel.scorer_behaviour_note: the official extractor has no failure state: if none of its answer prefixes is present the whole response is used and its first line compared. EXTRACTION_FAILURE is therefore not produced for BBEH; instead the flag no_answer_prefix is recorded and the official verdict stands.

prompt_template.note: task inputs carry no answer-format instruction and the pinned repo provides no suffix; the study-authored suffix requests the extractor's 'The answer is:' prefix. Not verified as the BBEH paper's verbatim prompt.

separate_diagnostic.protocol: all 541 original prompts UNCHANGED: no FINAL wrapper, no appended reasoning instruction; score the final-response channel only
metrics: loose variants reported separately and labelled supplemental
separate_diagnostic.role: instruction-following diagnostic; never merged with reasoning accuracy

excluded_before_outcomes.reason: gated dataset access and exact evaluator not confirmed at freeze time; excluded from this protocol version rather than added after seeing separation

prompt_construction.structure: single user message = verbatim task prompt; for the three capability benchmarks the task template itself carries the answer-format instruction; nothing else is appended
prompt_construction.system_message: none added by the study; native templates may inject their own effort/system prefix (recorded in the rendered-prompt log)
prompt_construction.rendered_prompt_log: every request stores the exact rendered string/token ids and their sha256

reasoning_channel_policy.answer_source: FINAL channel only (content after the native reasoning delimiter or the parser's 'content' field)
reasoning_channel_policy.reasoning_text: stored in full; never scored; a correct-looking answer inside reasoning with no final answer is NOT credited
reasoning_channel_policy.no_final: NO_FINAL_ANSWER (scored 0) when generation ends naturally without a final channel

primary_status_precedence: INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE (transport/backend crash/stall; attempt missing, rerun policy applies)
MALFORMED_NATIVE_OUTPUT (native parser rejects a naturally-stopped output, e.g. missing EOS/</think>, unexpected special tokens, tool call in a no-tools study)
BUDGET_TRUNCATED (output ceiling reached before a complete final channel)
NO_FINAL_ANSWER (natural stop, empty or absent final channel)
EXTRACTION_FAILURE (final channel present, scorer cannot extract an answer)
attempt_status.scoring: every status except INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE scores 0 for accuracy and counts in the denominator

retries.semantic_retries: none - a wrong, truncated, looping or unparseable answer is final
retries.infrastructure_reruns: up to 2 reruns of the same item with identical rendered prompt, settings and seed; if still failing the attempt is MISSING
retries.operational_watchdog: abort a request with no new token for 30 minutes or 48 hours total -> INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE (stall); these limits are operational, not capability budgets, and wall-clock speed never affects scores

budget_policy.design: one common output ceiling C (reasoning + final tokens) for all six configurations; matched-token sensitivity analyses derived post hoc from the same generations
budget_policy.terminal_ceiling_rule: T = min over models of (native_context - max_rendered_prompt_tokens_in_final_and_dev_sets - 1024 protocol overhead), rounded down to a multiple of 8192. P34's native 262,144-token context is binding; no context extension is enabled.

terminal_ceiling_value.status: pending: requires each model's tokenizer to count rendered prompt lengths (tokenizer vocabularies not downloaded)
terminal_ceiling_value.planning_estimate_only: the longest selected BBEH input is ~32,000 characters (~8-11K tokens depending on tokenizer), so T is expected near 245,760 (30 x 8192); this estimate must NOT be used as the frozen value

budget_policy.primary_ceiling: C = T (the largest ceiling valid for every configuration). Calibration cannot lower C to rescue cost or raise it for a favourite.

development_calibration.purpose: measure censoring at C on disjoint development items before any final generation; verify plumbing and stop semantics
development_calibration.adequacy_criterion: for each configuration, BUDGET_TRUNCATED rate on development items <= 5% with the upper 95% Wilson bound reported
development_calibration.if_criterion_fails: proceed at C anyway (no model-specific ceiling); flag the configuration 'budget-censored at the maximum valid common ceiling' in every table. Non-completion is a capability/configuration outcome, not an infrastructure error.
development_calibration.no_answer_tuning: development accuracy is recorded but may not change prompts, settings, models or C

post_hoc_matched_token_sensitivity.method: an attempt counts as completed at ceiling c only if its total generated tokens <= c; otherwise BUDGET_TRUNCATED at c. Valid because a lower cap does not change earlier tokens of the same generation; requires per-attempt token counts. Labelled sensitivity analysis, never the primary result.
post_hoc_matched_token_sensitivity.caveat: equal token caps are not equal compute across architectures/tokenizers

optional_secondary_condition.name: publisher-recommended output length
optional_secondary_condition.applies_to: configurations whose native context supports it without extension (not P34)
optional_secondary_condition.status: not part of this protocol's required work; may be added only by a pre-result amendment

generations_and_seeds.rationale: more distinct items beats repeated generations for estimating item-population accuracy; repeats would be clustered by item
generations_and_seeds.no_best_of: no pass@k, no majority vote, no selection among samples

statistical_plan.per_benchmark_estimate: accuracy with 95% Wilson interval, per configuration
statistical_plan.pairwise: 15 model pairs x 3 capability benchmarks = 45 paired comparisons; exact McNemar test on item-level correct/incorrect (missing items dropped pairwise, count reported); Holm correction across the 45; paired difference with 95% paired-bootstrap interval (10,000 resamples of items, seed 20260929)
statistical_plan.no_composite: no single intelligence score; an unweighted mean across the three benchmarks may be shown only as a labelled descriptive summary
statistical_plan.missing_data: primary analysis complete-case; sensitivity analysis scores MISSING as incorrect
statistical_plan.precision_statement: with n=400-460 per benchmark, a single accuracy has a 95% interval of roughly +/-4.5 percentage points near 50%; differences smaller than this are not claimed
statistical_plan.contamination: public benchmarks may be in training data; disjoint dev/final splits do not remove this; no decontamination claim

item_manifests.status: generated 2026-09-29 by manifest/generate_item_manifests.py (deterministic: identical output hashes on repeated runs)
item_manifests.isolation: item files hold ids/strata/content hashes only; gold answers only in answer_key_*.json; no id or content overlap between dev and final (asserted)

preflight_refusal: the runner must refuse final generation while calibrated=false or any model/evaluation field has status 'pending'
